note: Round-72 Bugzilla REST API core v1 bug endpoints. S107 is the Bugzilla 5.2+ documentation page 'REST API: Bugs' (core v1) as served: the get, create and update bug requests, the create parameter contract, the update comment object, the access sentences and the page's own statement that undocumented fields may change. It is the interface contract of one bug tracker, not a vendor reporting policy. Opened 2026-11-05.
